hints.title: Fixed Differences Lower Bound
hints.text: Any pair of adjacent elements where neither is -1 has a fixed difference that cannot be altered. The answer is at least the maximum of these fixed differences.

hints.title: Boundary Collection
hints.text: Collect all known numbers that are adjacent to at least one -1. To minimize differences, the two chosen replacement numbers x and y should cover this range of boundary elements.

hints.title: Binary Search Feasibility
hints.text: Binary search on candidate difference d. Verify whether all boundary elements can be covered by two intervals of radius d while connecting any adjacent -1 segments.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: max_val: range of values up to 10^9
complexity.notes: Binary search over maximum allowable difference with linear boundary interval feasibility checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all replacement value pairs (x, y) yields an impossible O(max_val^2) search space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space performing on-the-fly interval updates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models known neighbors of -1 elements as interval constraints and binary searches the difference.
